description:
Objective: Post-signing EPD is approved by the broker and a new EPD contract is generated.
Preconditions: Open Early payment discount with the configured test data.

1. Open Early payment discount.
2. Post-signing EPD is approved by the broker and a new EPD contract is generated.

Expected: The behavior named in the scenario is observed and its assertions pass.
